title: Parallel Prefix Computation
relevance: Foundational paper on parallel prefix computation with optimal O(n) work and O(log n) depth.

title: Data-Parallel Finite-State Machines
relevance: Applies parallel prefix to FSM transitions, the core technique for parallel Huffman decoding.

title: Prefix Sums and Their Applications
relevance: Comprehensive survey of parallel prefix (scan) applications including its use as a primitive for parallel algorithms.

title: Parallel Composition of Weighted Finite-State Transducers
relevance: Parallel FST composition on GPU, showing practical implementation of the algebraic composition that underpins prefix-scan FSM evaluation.
